following.rule: After an answer in which the operation has not ended, the client waits Retry-After seconds if the answer carried it, else its backoff. If that wait would reach the follow bound, it reports the operation as still running. Otherwise it reads the operation with wait = min(wait_s, whole seconds left before the bound).
